title: My Breakfast
text:
I like breakfast. Every morning, I eat bread with butter and drink a glass of milk. Sometimes I eat an apple too. My breakfast is small but good.

On Sunday, I have a big breakfast with my family. We make eggs and pancakes. My dad makes the coffee. We eat together and talk for a long time.

questions.text: What does the writer eat every morning?
What does the writer's dad make on Sunday?
Why is Sunday breakfast different from the other days?
options: The family eats together and has a bigger breakfast
The writer does not like bread
There is no milk on Sunday
The writer is sick on Sunday

questions.text: How does the writer feel about Sunday breakfast?
options: The writer feels happy about it
The writer feels bored by it
The writer feels angry about it
The writer feels tired of it

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
a soft yellow food you eat on bread
small, flat, round cakes made in a pan

paragraph_translations: Me gusta el desayuno. Cada mañana, como pan con mantequilla y bebo un vaso de leche. A veces también como una manzana. Mi desayuno es pequeño pero bueno.
El domingo, tengo un desayuno grande con mi familia. Hacemos huevos y panqueques. Mi papá hace el café. Comemos juntos y hablamos mucho tiempo.
